svg.text: Bevel sleeve supports | source and actual native shaft-height sections
Blue M259, bronze M261/M262, red M310/screw, green case. Source scale retained; two axial registrations shown explicitly.
Axial conflict: 32.113 mm. Local origin x1534 aligns the already centered case; the output datum is not changed.
Enlarged journals and bush/sleeve diameters are assembly-path hypotheses; outlines differ from the drawing.
Bevel gear wheels, clutch rings, central clutch, shims and rivets remain absent. These supports do not complete the axial stack.
